title: Climate change and long run factor shares
abstract: What is the long-run effect of climate change on how income is distributed between capital and labor? To answer this question, we develop an equilibrium growth model with labor- and capital-augmenting productivities that are affected by changes in temperature. We show that how temperature affects the long-run division of income only depends on the elasticity of substitution between labor and capital and how temperature affects capital-augmenting productivity. Labor-augmenting productivity and the elasticity of labor supply play no role in temperature's long-run effects on factor shares.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对资本与劳动之间收入分配的长期影响是什么？为回答这一问题，我们构建了一个均衡增长模型，其中劳动增强型和资本增强型生产率受温度变化影响。我们证明，温度对长期收入分配格局的影响仅取决于劳动与资本之间的替代弹性，以及温度对资本增强型生产率的影响方式。劳动增强型生产率和劳动供给弹性在温度对要素份额的长期效应中不起作用。

title: Economic geography and air pollution regulation in the United States
abstract: We develop a quantitative economic geography model with endogenous emissions, amenities, trade, and labor reallocation to evaluate the spatial impact of the leading air quality regulation in the United States: the National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS). We find that the NAAQS generate $40 billion in annual welfare gains, first-best emissions pricing would increase this by an additional $70 billion, gains are concentrated in a small set of cities, and improved amenities attract nonmanufacturing workers. Atmospheric transport of emissions, labor reallocation, and trade are first-order factors for quantifying the level and distribution of both costs and benefits of the NAAQS.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含内生排放、舒适度、贸易和劳动力再配置的定量经济地理模型，以评估美国最主要的空气质量法规——《国家环境空气质量标准》（NAAQS）的空间影响。我们发现，NAAQS每年带来400亿美元的福利收益；若采用第一最优的排放定价，还可额外增加700亿美元收益；收益集中在少数几个城市；改善的舒适度吸引了非制造业工人。大气中污染物的传输、劳动力再配置和贸易，是量化NAAQS的成本与收益的水平及分布的首要因素。

title: The social value of hurricane forecasts
abstract: What is the impact and value of hurricane forecasts? We study this question using the universe of landfalling US hurricanes between 2005-2022.We find that forecasts drive adaptive protective expenditures, and that erroneous underforecasts result in a significant increase in total hurricane damage. Using a theoretically-grounded approach for estimating the marginal value of forecast improvements, we find that improvements since 2007, after the implementation of a national policy to improve hurricane forecasts, have reduced total costs by 23%, averaging $2 billion per hurricane. These benefits far exceed the annual budget of the policy and of all federal weather forecasting.
abstract_zh: 飓风预报的影响和价值是什么？我们利用2005至2022年间美国登陆飓风的全部样本研究这一问题。我们发现，预报会推动适应性防护支出，而预报偏低的错误会导致飓风总损失显著增加。我们采用一种有理论基础的方法估计预报改进的边际价值，发现自2007年国家政策实施以来、为改进飓风预报而取得的进展已使总成本降低了23%，平均每次飓风节省20亿美元。这些收益远超该政策以及美国联邦所有天气预报工作的年度预算。

title: Bird Returns on public investment in the Conservation Reserve Program
abstract: Participatory science offers unprecedented opportunities to evaluate biodiversity outcomes of policy instruments at low cost. Leveraging data from eBird, we evaluated outcomes of the U.S. Farm Bill’s Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) from 2008–2019. Results provide the first causal evidence that CRP enrollment increases abundance and richness of grassland birds across 13 Midwestern states. Counterfactual analyses indicate that ~ 100M grassland birds may have been lost amid enrollment declines since 2007. However, alternative targeting strategies can dramatically and cost-efficiently improve conservation outcomes. Specifically, cost- and benefit-cost targeting could more than double bird returns per dollar spent, especially when allocations are flexible across states. Overall, results demonstrate that strategic, data-driven targeting of CRP allocations can improve both biodiversity benefits and economic efficiency of conservation investments.
abstract_zh: 参与式科学以低成本评估政策工具的生物多样性成果提供了前所未有的机会。利用eBird的数据，我们评估了美国《农场法案》保护储备计划（CRP）在2008年至2019年间的成果。结果首次提供了因果证据，表明CRP的参与提高了中西部13个州草原鸟类的丰度和物种丰富度。反事实分析表明，在2007年以来参与规模下降的情况下，可能已损失了约1亿只草原鸟类。然而，替代的目标选择策略可以显著且具有成本效益地改善保护成果。具体而言，基于成本和效益—成本的目标选择，可以使每美元支出的鸟类收益增加一倍以上，特别是在各州之间的分配具有灵活性的情况下。总体而言，研究结果表明，对CRP分配进行战略性、数据驱动的目标选择，可以同时提高生物多样性效益和保护投资的经济效率。

title: Are carbon tariffs climate policy?
abstract: Carbon import tariffs, traditionally considered a complement to domestic climate policy, are increasingly proposed as standalone policies. We build a quantitative trade model to compare U.S. carbon tariffs with and without a domestic carbon tax, each applied to a set of carbon-intensive, trade-exposed sectors. We find three main results. First, a U.S. carbon tariff increases U.S. emissions, lowers foreign emissions, and on net achieves half the global emissions reductions of the combined policy, which lowers both U.S. and foreign emissions. Second, both approaches increase U.S. GDP and welfare, but the combined policy has a larger effect due to terms of trade improvements. Third, global emissions reductions from multilateral tariff-only agreements are modest and do not increase monotonically with greater membership, whereas under combined policies they scale considerably with membership.
abstract_zh: 碳进口关税传统上被视为国内气候政策的补充，但如今越来越多地被提议作为独立政策。我们构建了一个定量贸易模型，比较美国在有国内碳税和无国内碳税两种情形下，分别对一组碳密集型、贸易暴露型行业征收碳关税的效果。我们得出三个主要结论。第一，美国碳关税会增加美国排放、降低外国排放，且总体上只能实现两项政策组合减排效果的一半，而组合政策会同时降低美国和外国的排放。第二，两种方式都会提高美国GDP和福利，但由于贸易条件改善，组合政策的效果更大。第三，多边仅含关税的协议所带来的全球减排效果有限，且不会随成员数量增加而单调上升，而在组合政策下，减排效果会随成员数量显著增长。

title: Pollution pricing in equilibrium: Production, reallocation, and aggregate impacts
abstract: How much does pricing pollution cut aggregate emissions, and at what cost? We develop a microfounded equilibrium model of firm production and abatement that can be estimated from standard firm financial and emissions data, without observing abatement effort directly. The model captures three adjustment margins: short-run input substitution, reallocation of output from dirty to cleaner firms, and long-run clean technology adoption. Applying it to the first 17 years of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU-ETS), we find input substitution is rigid: firms cannot cut emissions in the short run without cutting output. Reallocation instead drives nearly all of the short-run aggregate emissions response, concentrated in sectors with heterogeneous emissions intensities, like power and cement, or with elastic demand, like refining. Clean technology adoption also responds causally to permit price shocks, reducing firms' emissions intensity over the five years that follow. Doubling the permit price cuts aggregate emissions 23% in the short run and 31% in the longer run after induced clean technology adoption. In the short run, output falls by 4%, primarily because carbon costs pass from upstream polluting industries like electricity to downstream producers. In the long run, output falls just 2.5%, as clean technology adoption dampens these supply-chain impacts. Carbon pricing thus delivers substantial emissions reductions with moderate output effects, and much of the economic burden falls on downstream firms through higher upstream input costs.
abstract_zh: 对污染进行定价能在多大程度上降低总排放，代价又是多少？我们构建了一个具有微观基础的企业生产与减排均衡模型，该模型可以利用标准的企业财务和排放数据进行估计，而无需直接观测减排努力。该模型刻画了三个调整渠道：短期的投入替代、产出从高排放企业向低排放企业的再配置，以及长期的清洁技术采用。将该模型应用于欧盟排放交易体系（EU-ETS）的前17年，我们发现投入替代是僵化的：企业在短期内无法在不减少产出的情况下削减排放。相反，再配置几乎驱动了全部的短期总量排放响应，并集中于排放强度存在异质性的行业（如电力和水泥），或需求富有弹性的行业（如炼油）。清洁技术采用也对排放许可价格冲击产生因果性的响应，并在随后的五年内降低了企业的排放强度。将排放许可价格翻倍，可使总排放在短期内降低23%，在考虑诱致性清洁技术采用后的长期内降低31%。在短期内，产出下降4%，主要原因是碳成本从电力等上游高污染行业传导至下游生产者。在长期内，产出仅下降2.5%，因为清洁技术采用缓解了这些供应链影响。因此，碳定价能够带来可观的减排效果，同时产出影响适中，且大部分经济负担通过上游投入成本的提高而落在下游企业身上。

title: The economic effects of climate change in dynamic spatial equilibrium
abstract: We develop a dynamic-spatial equilibrium model to quantify the economic effects of climate change with a focus on the United States. We find that climate change reduces US welfare by 4% and global welfare by over 20%. Market- based adaptation through trade and labor reallocation increases US welfare, but with substantial spatial heterogeneity. Adaptation through labor reallocation and trade are complementary: together they boost welfare by 50% more than their individual effects. We additionally develop a new dynamic envelope theo- rem method for measuring welfare impacts in reduced form and to validate our quantitative model. We find that welfare distributions from our two approaches are consistent, indicating that our quantitative model captures the first-order factors for measuring the distributional impacts of climate change. The level and distribution of the economic impacts of climate change depends the sectoral and spatial structure of the economy, and the extent to which different markets can adapt.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个动态空间均衡模型，以量化气候变化的经济效应，重点关注美国。我们发现，气候变化使美国福利下降4%，使全球福利下降超过20%。通过贸易和劳动力再配置实现的市场化适应能够提高美国福利，但存在显著的空间异质性。劳动力再配置与贸易适应具有互补性：二者共同作用使福利提高的幅度比各自单独效果之和高出50%。我们还开发了一种新的动态包络定理方法，用于以简约形式测度福利影响，并检验我们的定量模型。我们发现，两种方法得出的福利分布结果一致，表明我们的定量模型抓住了测度气候变化分配效应的主要因素。气候变化经济影响的水平与分布，取决于经济的部门结构与空间结构，以及不同市场能够适应的程度。

title: A thousand cuts: Cumulative lead exposure reduces academic achievement
Economic activity and biodiversity in the United States
abstract: The environmental impacts of economic activities extend beyond those directly affecting humans. This paper provides new evidence on the link between economic activity and ecosystem decline using a novel dataset that compiles longitudinal ecological sampling information at tens of thousands of locations across the United States between 1960 and 2015. Local shocks in economic activities, such as those driven by national military buildups, led to a significant reduction in species abundance, diversity, and stability, with one-third of the observed effects explained by the causal impact of air pollution. Government environmental regulations significantly mitigated pollution externalities. • We provide the first causal estimates of how economic activity reduces ecosystem biodiversity across taxa, using national military buildup shocks as quasi-exogenous variation. • Our analysis leverages millions of ecological observations from the BioTIME database, which allow us to construct longitudinal measures of species abundance, richness, and stability across the U.S. from 1960 to 2015. • We identify air pollution as a key causal channel, showing it accounts for about a third of the biodiversity impact from economic shocks using an upwind pollution IV strategy. • Environmental regulations such as the Clean Air Act significantly mitigate biodiversity losses, suggesting economic policies that protect human health also confer large ecological co-benefits.
abstract_zh: 经济活动的环境影响超出了直接影响人类的范畴。本文利用一个新数据集，为经济活动与生态系统衰退之间的联系提供了新的证据。该数据集汇集了1960年至2015年间美国数万个地点的纵向生态抽样信息。经济活动的局部冲击（例如由全国性军备扩张所驱动的冲击）导致物种丰度、多样性和稳定性显著下降，其中三分之一的观测效应可由空气污染的因果影响所解释。政府的环境监管显著缓解了污染外部性。•我们首次利用全国性军备扩张冲击作为准外生变异，提供了经济活动如何减少各类群生态系统生物多样性的因果估计。•我们的分析利用了数百万条生态观测数据，这些数据使我们能够构建1960年至2015年间美国物种丰度、丰富度和稳定性的纵向指标。•我们将空气污染确定为关键的因果渠道，并利用上风向污染工具变量策略表明，其约占经济冲击所致生物多样性影响的三分之一。•《清洁空气法》等环境法规显著减轻了生物多样性损失，这表明保护人类健康的经济政策也带来了巨大的生态协同效益。

title: Equity and efficiency in the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law's adaptation investments
venue: NBER Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy

title: Synthesis of evidence yields high social cost of carbon due to structural model variation and uncertainties
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Estimating the cost to society from a ton of CO2—termed the social cost of carbon (SCC)—requires connecting a model of the climate system with a representation of the economic and social effects of changes in climate, and the aggregation of diverse, uncertain impacts across both time and space. A growing literature has examined the effect of fundamental structural elements of the models supporting SCC calculations. This work has accumulated in a piecemeal fashion, leaving their relative importance unclear. Here, we perform a comprehensive synthesis of the evidence on the SCC, combining 1,823 estimates of the SCC from 147 studies with a survey of authors of these studies. The distribution of published 2020 SCC values is wide and substantially right-skewed, showing evidence of a heavy right tail (truncated mean of $132). ANOVA reveals important roles for the inclusion of persistent damages, the representation of the Earth system, and distributional weighting. However, our survey reveals that experts believe the literature underestimates the SCC due to an undersampling of model structures, incomplete characterization of damages, and high discount rates. To address this imbalance, we train a random forest model on variation in the literature and use it to generate a synthetic SCC distribution that more closely matches expert assessments of appropriate model structure and discounting. This synthetic distribution has a mean of $283 per ton CO2 for a 2020 pulse year (5% to 95% range: $32 to $874), higher than most official government estimates, including a 2023 update from the U.S. EPA.
abstract_zh: 估算一吨二氧化碳给社会带来的成本，即碳的社会成本（SCC），需要将气候系统模型与气候变化的经济和社会效应表征连接起来，并在时间和空间上汇总多样且不确定的影响。已有大量文献考察了支撑SCC计算的模型中基本结构要素的作用，但这些研究较为零散地积累，使得各要素的相对重要性仍不明确。在此，我们对SCC的证据进行了全面综合，汇集了来自147项研究的1,823个SCC估计值，并结合了对这些研究作者的问卷调查。已发表的2020年SCC值分布较为分散，且明显右偏，呈现出较重的右尾（截尾均值为132美元）。方差分析显示，持续性损害的纳入、地球系统的刻画以及分配权重设定均具有重要作用。然而，我们的调查表明，专家认为由于模型结构取样不足、损害刻画不完整以及贴现率过高，文献低估了SCC。为纠正这种失衡，我们在文献中的变异上训练了一个随机森林模型，并利用它生成一个合成SCC分布，该分布更接近专家对适当模型结构和贴现的评估。该合成分布在2020年脉冲年份下的均值为每吨二氧化碳283美元（5%至95%分位区间：32美元至874美元），高于大多数官方政府估计，包括美国环保署（EPA）2023年的更新值。

title: The effect of leaded gasoline on elderly mortality: Evidence from regulatory exemptions
abstract: Leaded gasoline is still used globally for aviation and automotive racing. Exploiting regulatory exemptions and a novel quasi-experiment, we find that leaded gasoline use in racing increases ambient lead, elevated blood lead rates, and elderly mortality. The mortality estimates indicate that each gram of lead added to gasoline exceeds $1,100 in damages. Our setting allows us to rule out potential confounders, such as correlated pollutants or socioeconomic status. We provide the first causal estimates linking adult mortality to leaded gasoline, highlight the value of banning on-road leaded gasoline, and present policy-relevant cost estimates at the lowest ambient levels to date. (JEL I12, J14, L71, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 含铅汽油目前仍在全球范围内用于航空和汽车赛车。利用监管豁免和一项新颖的准自然实验，我们发现赛车中使用含铅汽油会增加环境中的铅含量、提高血铅水平，并提高老年人死亡率。死亡率估计表明，汽油中每添加一克铅造成的损害超过1100美元。我们的研究背景使我们能够排除潜在的混杂因素，例如伴随污染物或社会经济地位。我们首次给出了成人死亡率与含铅汽油之间的因果估计，突出了禁止道路用含铅汽油的价值，并在迄今最低的环境浓度水平下给出了与政策相关的成本估计。（JEL I12, J14, L71, Q51, Q53）

title: Conservation co-benefits from pollution regulation: Evidence from birds
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Massive wildlife losses over the past 50 years have brought new urgency to identifying both the drivers of population decline and potential solutions. We provide the first large-scale evidence that air pollution, specifically ozone, is associated with declines in bird abundance in the United States. We show that an air pollution regulation limiting ozone precursors emissions has delivered substantial benefits to bird conservation. Our estimates imply that air quality improvements over the past four decades have stemmed the decline in bird populations, averting the loss of 1.5 billion birds, approximately 20 percent of current totals. Our results highlight that in addition to protecting human health, air pollution regulations have previously unrecognized and unquantified conservation co-benefits.
abstract_zh: 过去50年间野生动物的大规模减少，使人们迫切需要找出种群下降的驱动因素以及可能的解决方案。我们首次提供大规模证据表明，空气污染，特别是臭氧，与美国鸟类数量的下降相关。我们表明，限制臭氧前体物排放的一项空气污染管制措施，为鸟类保护带来了实质性效益。我们的估计表明，过去四十年的空气质量改善遏制了鸟类种群的下降，避免了15亿只鸟类的损失，约占当前总量的20%。我们的研究结果表明，除了保护人类健康之外，空气污染管制还带来了此前未被认识、也未经量化的保护协同效益。

title: Costs of inefficient regulation: Evidence from the Bakken
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Optimal climate policy when damages are unknown
abstract: Integrated assessment models (IAMs) are economists’ primary tool for analyzing the optimal carbon tax. Damage functions, which link temperature to economic impacts, have come under fire because of their assumptions that may be incorrect in significant but a priori unknowable ways. Here I develop recursive IAM frameworks to model uncertainty, learning, and concern for misspecification about damages. I decompose the carbon tax into channels capturing state uncertainty, insurance motives, and precautionary saving. Damage learning improves ex ante welfare by $750 billion. If damage functions are misspecified and omit the potential for catastrophic damages, robust control may be beneficial ex post. (JEL H23, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 综合评估模型（IAMs）是经济学家分析最优碳税的主要工具。损害函数将温度与经济影响联系起来，因其假设可能在某些重要但先验上无法得知的方面有误而遭到批评。本文构建了递归综合评估模型框架，用以刻画关于损害的不确定性、学习过程以及对设定误差的担忧。我将碳税分解为状态不确定性、保险动机和预防性储蓄等渠道。损害学习使事前福利提高了7500亿美元。如果损害函数设定有误，且遗漏了灾难性损害的可能性，稳健控制在事后可能是有益的。（JEL H23, Q54, Q58）

title: External impacts of local energy policy: The case of renewable portfolio standards
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Renewable portfolio standards (RPSs) are state level policies that require in-state electricity providers to procure a minimum percentage of electricity sales from renewable sources. Using theoretical and empirical models, we show how RPSs induce out-of-state emissions reductions through inter-state trade of credits used for RPS compliance. When one state passes an RPS, it increases demand for credits sold by firms in other (potentially non-RPS) states. We find that increasing a state's RPS decreases coal generation and increases wind generation in outside states through this tradable credit channel. We perform a welfare simulation to evaluate the aggregate avoided damage from RPS-induced reductions in local coal-fired pollutants. Our estimates suggest that a 1 percentage point increase in a state's RPS results in up to $100 million in avoided damages over the United States from reduced pollution. We also find substantial heterogeneity in aggregate avoided damages caused by increases in different states' RPSs.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源组合标准（RPS）是州级政策，要求在州内经营的电力供应商从可再生能源中采购最低比例的电力销售量。利用理论和实证模型，我们展示了RPS如何通过用于RPS合规的证书在州际间的交易，促成州外的减排。当一个州通过RPS时，会增加对其他（可能没有RPS的）州企业所出售证书的需求。我们发现，提高一个州的RPS会通过这一可交易证书渠道减少外州的燃煤发电量，并增加风力发电量。我们进行了福利模拟，以评估RPS引起的地方燃煤污染物减排所避免的总损害。我们的估计表明，一个州的RPS每提高1个百分点，美国全境因减少污染而避免的损害可达1亿美元。我们还发现，不同州RPS提高所带来的总体避免损害存在显著异质性。

title: Air pollution and visitation at U.S. national parks
abstract: Hundreds of millions of visitors travel to U.S. national parks every year to visit America's iconic landscapes. Concerns about air quality in these areas have led to strict, yet controversial pollution control policies. We document pollution trends in U.S. national parks and estimate the relationship between pollution and park visitation. From 1990 to 2014, average ozone concentrations in national parks were statistically indistinguishable from the 20 largest U.S. metropolitan areas. Further, relative to U.S. cities, national parks have seen only modest reductions in days with ozone concentrations exceeding levels deemed unhealthy by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. We find a robust, negative relationship between in-park ozone concentrations and park visitation. Still, 35% of all national park visits occur when ozone levels are elevated.
abstract_zh: 每年有数亿游客前往美国国家公园，欣赏美国标志性的自然景观。这些地区的空气质量问题引发了严格但存在争议的污染控制政策。我们记录了美国国家公园的污染趋势，并估计了污染与公园游客量之间的关系。1990年至2014年间，国家公园的平均臭氧浓度与美国20个最大都市区在统计上无显著差异。此外，相较于美国城市，国家公园中臭氧浓度超过美国环境保护署认定的不健康水平的天数仅有适度减少。我们发现公园内臭氧浓度与游客量之间存在稳健的负相关关系。尽管如此，仍有35%的国家公园游览发生在臭氧水平升高的时候。

title: Tradable credit markets for intensity standards
Managing climate change under uncertainty: Recursive integrated assessment at an inflection point
abstract: Uncertainty is critical to questions about climate change policy. Recently developed recursive integrated assessment models have become the primary tools for studying and quantifying the policy implications of uncertainty. We decompose the channels through which uncertainty affects policy and quantify them in a recursive extension of a benchmark integrated assessment model. The first wave of recursive models has made valuable, pioneering efforts at analyzing disparate sources of uncertainty. We argue that frontier numerical methods will enable the next generation of recursive models to better capture the information structure of climate change and to thereby ask new types of questions about climate change policy.
abstract_zh: 不确定性是气候变化政策问题的关键所在。近期发展起来的递归综合评估模型已成为研究和量化不确定性所带来的政策影响的主要工具。我们分解了不确定性影响政策的各条渠道，并在一个基准综合评估模型的递归扩展中对其进行量化。第一代递归模型在分析各类不同的不确定性来源方面作出了宝贵的开创性努力。我们认为，前沿的数值方法将使下一代递归模型能够更好地刻画气候变化的信息结构，从而提出关于气候变化政策的新类型问题。

title: Steering the climate system: Using inertia to lower the cost of policy
abstract: Common views hold that the efficient way to limit warming to a chosen level is to price carbon emissions at a rate that increases exponentially. We show that this Hotelling tax on carbon emissions is actually inefficient. The least-cost policy path takes advantage of the climate system's inertia to delay reducing emissions and allow greater cumulative emissions. The efficient carbon tax follows an inverse-U-shaped path and grows more slowly than the Hotelling tax. Economic models that assume exponentially increasing carbon taxes are overestimating the cost of limiting warming, overestimating the efficient near-term carbon tax, and overvaluing technologies that mature sooner. (JEL H23, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 一种普遍观点认为，将变暖控制在既定水平之内的有效方式，是按指数增长的速率为碳排放定价。我们证明，这种霍特林碳税实际上是低效的。成本最小的政策路径利用气候系统的惯性来推迟减排，从而允许更多的累计排放。有效的碳税呈倒U形路径，且增长速度慢于霍特林碳税。假定碳税呈指数增长的经济模型高估了将变暖控制在一定水平的成本，高估了有效的近期碳税水平，并高估了较早成熟技术的价值。（JEL H23, Q54, Q58）
